ThingDef.label: Reclamation company contact computer
ThingDef.description: The contact terminal between company headquarters and the reclamation teams. On its cold screen, distant orders still scroll line by line.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Qinxintang
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Qinxintang
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc:
Qinxintang: Hello. Hold on a moment, let me turn the contact log over... Hm? You just want to chat?
Qinxintang: Then I can write a few less lines this time. How has your day been?

li.label: Nothing much today. And you?
li.desc: Qinxintang: I just mistook a supply list for a flavor list and spent ages seriously wondering what steel should be paired with. Good thing I had not sent it yet.

li.label: I would like to hear about your travels.
li.desc: Qinxintang: Sometimes learning one hard problem is less useful than learning to ask for directions in a strange place. When someone is willing to point out a road, you can save a long detour.

li.label: Let us stop here for today.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Amber candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Amber candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc: Amber candy: There are no new calls for help today. You do not need to get up and look for your gear just yet.

li.label: What do you do when you are not watching over everyone?
li.desc: Amber candy: Sometimes I sit near everyone and listen to their bits and pieces. That they can all work in peace is good enough.

li.label: When you protect your companions, do you always want to carry everything yourself?
li.desc: Amber candy: I do. But saying out loud what needs help is also protection. If I am the only one who knows where things are giving way, no one even gets the chance to take over.

li.label: Let us stop here for today.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Nectar candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Nectar candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc: Nectar candy: Did you eat properly today? This is not an inspection - I forget too when I get busy.

li.label: I ate. Just a little tired.
li.desc: Nectar candy: Then find somewhere you can sit down. Talk if you want to; if not, you do not have to keep looking for words just to fill the silence.

li.label: Any small trick to help someone relax?
li.desc: Nectar candy: First I sort what is left of today. Things that must be done now stay; the rest are allowed to wait.

li.label: Someone in the kitchen is trying a new flavor.
Let us stop here for today.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Mecha candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Mecha candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc: Mecha candy: I am revising a sketch. What has me stuck is not the structure, but the line of names beside it.

li.label: Are names really that important?
li.desc: Mecha candy: A broken structure can be fixed. Once everyone has a name comfortably on their tongue, getting them to change back is hard.

li.label: Let me help you think about it?
li.desc: Mecha candy: Fine. Just discussion on paper - I am not asking you to build me one right now.

li.label: Let us stop here for today.
When I prepare for something, I always feel something is still missing.
li.desc: Prism candy: Check the route first, then the gear. Judge the rest when you arrive. Do not just stand there thinking.

li.label: What do you like to do in your spare time?
li.desc: Prism candy: Walk. Pick a quiet road; it need not be far.

li.label: Let us stop here for today.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Linglon candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Linglon candy
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc: Linglon candy: Connected! No task this time, you came just to chat? Then I want to hear something new.

li.label: Honestly I have nothing particular to say; I just wanted someone to talk to.
li.desc: Linglon candy: Perfect timing - I will ask first! Was there any little thing today that made you laugh without meaning to? If not, that is fine, we can change the subject.

li.label: Would you be willing to talk about the past?
li.desc: Linglon candy: Sure! From the beginning: we first travelled with Qinxintang, and only later did the Alliance come about. Do not rush me - we have not even reached those task lists you know so well.

li.label: Let us stop here for today.
